name: The Fitzwilliam Hotel
insider_take: Dublin's most stylish hideaway where contemporary luxury meets Georgian elegance in the heart of St. Stephen's Green.
whats_special: The Fitzwilliam boasts the only rooftop bar in Dublin city center with panoramic views over St. Stephen's Green. This boutique gem sits directly opposite Ireland's most famous park and features striking contemporary Irish art throughout, including works by renowned local artists. The hotel's Michelin-recommended restaurant showcases modern Irish cuisine with ingredients sourced from Dublin's historic Temple Bar markets.
pro_tip: Book a Green-facing room on floors 5-7 for the best park views, and visit the rooftop bar at sunset for Instagram-worthy shots of Dublin's skyline stretching to the Dublin Mountains.
dont_miss: Take the 2-minute walk to the National Gallery of Ireland and Trinity College's Book of Kells. The hotel's location puts you within steps of Grafton Street's shopping district and just around the corner from the famous Davy Byrnes pub, featured in James Joyce's "Ulysses." The nearby Iveagh Gardens offer a secret escape that most tourists never discover.
pros: Prime location overlooking St. Stephen's Green in Dublin city center
Contemporary luxury design with elegant interiors and modern amenities
Award-winning rooftop restaurant Citron with panoramic city views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Busy city center location may not suit guests seeking tranquility
